title: Alphabetical Exposure and Academic Careers in Chinese Science
domain: science of science / scientometrics / sociology of science / names research
summary: A population-calibrated, cross-disciplinary study testing whether Chinese surname alphabetical position interacts with empirically measured alphabetical-authorship regimes to shape visibility, collaboration, citation, mobility, and career outcomes among Chinese scholars.
